F1A_TIGHT.A1_symbolic_sequence_clarity: Clear but compressed; overlap makes the succession read closer to a quick ripple than a deliberate one-after-another signature.
F1A_TIGHT.A2_cross_surface_restraint: Prompt and restrained, but the speed reduces the perceptual distinction that justified F1 over generic entrance motion.
F1A_TIGHT.A3_generic_ui_cascade_risk: Highest of the F1 variants. The 70 ms onset interval approaches familiar list/card cascade behavior.
F1A_TIGHT.A4_false_literal_semantics_risk: Low-to-moderate because the sequence resolves quickly, though this advantage comes at the cost of symbolic clarity.
F1A_TIGHT.A5_temporal_drag: Lowest F1 drag; 670 ms total is comfortably prompt.
F1A_TIGHT.A6_f4_reference_check: Composed, but gains speed by sacrificing some of F1's ownable succession.

F1B_REFERENCE.A1_symbolic_sequence_clarity: Strong. Each onset is distinct while the motions still overlap enough to read as one coherent event.
F1B_REFERENCE.A2_cross_surface_restraint: Best F1 balance. The same 90/520 timing remains composed at both 56 px WEB and 28 px APP displacement.
F1B_REFERENCE.A3_generic_ui_cascade_risk: Lower than F1A: the cadence feels intentionally measured rather than merely staggered for polish.
F1B_REFERENCE.A4_false_literal_semantics_risk: Moderate-low. Overlap keeps the tokens perceptually related rather than suggesting four completed dependent steps.
F1B_REFERENCE.A5_temporal_drag: Good; 790 ms total leaves enough temporal identity without approaching a full-second wait.
F1B_REFERENCE.A6_f4_reference_check: Closest F1 variant to F4's composure while preserving the Director-valued succession.

F1C_MEASURED.A1_symbolic_sequence_clarity: Strongest F1 succession; the one-after-another pattern is unmistakable.
F1C_MEASURED.A2_cross_surface_restraint: Still mechanically clean, but the 890 ms span makes the APP context feel more ceremonious than necessary despite reduced displacement.
F1C_MEASURED.A3_generic_ui_cascade_risk: Low generic-cascade risk; cadence is distinctive.
F1C_MEASURED.A4_false_literal_semantics_risk: Highest F1 risk. The greater temporal separation begins to resemble actual ordered progress or dependent steps.
F1C_MEASURED.A5_temporal_drag: Borderline within the frozen under-one-second law; it is the only F1 variant that approaches the wait threshold perceptually.
F1C_MEASURED.A6_f4_reference_check: Preserves identity strongly but moves furthest away from F4's temporal economy.

F4_REFERENCE.A1_symbolic_sequence_clarity: No ordered-onset succession; it cannot express the Director-selected one-after-another identity by itself.
F4_REFERENCE.A3_generic_ui_cascade_risk: Not applicable as an ordered cascade; remains a useful restraint baseline.
F4_REFERENCE.A4_false_literal_semantics_risk: Very low because all peers move together.
F4_REFERENCE.A6_f4_reference_check: Retained as the benchmark, not recommended to replace F1 under the current adjudication.

design_sol_conclusion: F1B_REFERENCE is the strongest provisional cadence because it preserves unmistakable succession, avoids F1A's generic ripple risk, avoids F1C's literal-process/drag risk, and comes closest to F4's composure without surrendering the symbolic sequence that gives F1 product meaning.
